description: Convert a DAW project, rebuilt natively in the target: tracks, MIDI, audio clips, tempo and markers arrive editable (Logic/Ableton/Pro Tools/REAPER pairs also automation, buses/sends, plugin state; into FL 3rd-party plugins only). Sources: Logic .logicx, Ableton .als, FL .flp, Pro Tools .ptx, REAPER .rpp, Cubase .cpr, Dorico .dorico/.musicxml, Studio One .song, GarageBand .band (SOURCE only — zip the .band package like a .logicx; a GarageBand 6 project must be re-saved in GarageBand 10), Bitwig = any .dawproject (Bitwig/Studio One/Cubase export it; a native .bwproject is refused — File > Export… > DAWproject in Bitwig). The enum lists the exact pairs. ★ ASYMMETRIC TARGETS (an undocumented native file is never written): TO Cubase, Studio One or Bitwig = ONE .dawproject the app imports, not a .cpr/.song/.bwproject; TO Dorico = MusicXML (.mxl, Dorico's own notation import), not a .dorico. FROM Cubase the .cpr carries tracks, tempo and MIDI parts but not the audio pool (audio tracks arrive empty). FROM Dorico a .dorico carries players and flows but NOT its notes: convert its MusicXML export instead (.musicxml/.mxl accepted under dorico2*). Every result carries a transfer REPORT: `report`, `lossy`, `summary[]` (what changed), `warnings[]` (read before opening) — relay them; silence is never "lossless". Upload first: doseedo_get_project_upload_url + PUT (zip a project FOLDER so its audio travels; a bare project file works too; multipart past ~4 GB). Directions: "<source>2<target>"; "auto2<target>" detects the source; "<daw>2<daw>" rebuilds Logic/Ableton/FL/REAPER/Pro Tools in place (e.g. options.third_party_plugins:"disable"). To EDIT a project use doseedo_import_project; to convert a session the tools built: doseedo_download_session → upload that zip → logic2<target> (not a session_id). Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task (15 s–2 min; `stage`); `file` is a direct storage link. Cancel: no stop — it completes, the job ends canceled, output discarded; the credit is refunded only when the conversion itself fails.

direction.description: Source and target as "<source>2<target>" (logic | ableton | fl | protools | reaper | cubase | dorico | studioone | bitwig | garageband), "auto2<target>" to let the server detect the source, or "<daw>2<daw>" to rebuild in the same format (Logic/Ableton/FL/REAPER/Pro Tools only). cubase2* reads a .cpr and *2cubase writes a .dawproject (Cubase 14+/Nuendo open it natively). dorico2* reads a .dorico, .musicxml or .mxl and *2dorico writes MusicXML (.mxl). studioone2* reads a .song and *2studioone writes a .dawproject (Studio One 6.5+ imports it). bitwig2* reads any .dawproject and *2bitwig writes a .dawproject (Bitwig 5+ imports it). garageband2* reads a zipped .band package (source only — no *2garageband).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

options.description: Conversion options (all optional). third_party_plugins:"disable" drops third-party AU/VST devices so the export opens clean on a machine without them; stock_plugins:"disable" leaves stock devices unmapped instead of mapping to the nearest target-DAW device; carry_plugin_presets:false strips plugin patches; lossless:true (→Logic) pins the project to the MAX clip sample rate so no clip is downsampled; project_rate (→Logic) pins an exact rate in Hz; silence_empty_sampler:false (→Logic) keeps Logic's audible default Quick Sampler on tracks whose sampler had no sample; source_name = the project's display name for the output file.

source_name.description: Display name of the source project, e.g. "My Song.als" — names the output.

project_key.description: R2 key of the uploaded project (from doseedo_get_project_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/signed-url; starts with "uploads/").

name: doseedo_convert_project
title: Convert a DAW project
